summary: Trip.com Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with exhibits including a press release and notice for its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 30, 2026. The AGM will consider routine resolutions; record date is May 29, 2026. No special situation—such as acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer—is present. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer, and no special-situations category applies.
